context: Riku tells Aoi about an Okinawa school trip.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (インド/沖縄/里/突然/大量) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行で、沖縄に行ったよ!
lines.en: We went to Okinawa on a school trip!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね!沖縄、どうだった?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 大量の魚が、海にいたんだ!
lines.en: There were masses of fish in the sea!
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 突然、雨は降らなかった?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 突然のスコールで、びしょ濡れになったよ。
lines.en: A sudden squall left me drenched.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 世界には、インドとかも行ってみたいね。
lines.en: I'd like to visit places like India in the world too.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、インドの大量の人も見てみたい。
lines.en: Yeah, I want to see India's masses of people.
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 帰ったら、里のみんなに自慢しなよ!
lines.en: When you're back, brag to everyone in your hometown!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
